# Isaiah Chapter 59 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 21 verses]*

*Sin separates; no justice; truth stumbles; God puts on armor; Redeemer comes to Zion*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** The LORD's arm is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear. This chapter sin separates.

*-- LOGOS*
